title: Illusion of Control
coreMove: Test the appearance created by illusion of control, then replace it with a visible check on reality.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Illusion of Control as a specific decision error around illusion of control, placebo buttons, casino dice. Traceable support includes Heads I win, tails it.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Illusion of Control as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: test the appearance created by illusion of control, then replace it with a visible check on reality.
